关键词: Annual Report for the year ended December 31, 2015
主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on March 31, 2016. The filing includes an annual report for the year ended December 31, 2015. The report is part of the company's compliance with U.S. securities regulations. The filing was signed by A.J. Silber, the Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. The document is available as part of the Exhibit List to the Form 6-K. This report is a routine filing and does not contain any new or significant financial information beyond what was previously disclosed.
